SRC-274:R001.text: F-01 P0 HISTORY/REPORT_AUTHORITY: an improve report's authority keys (source_head, source_tree_fingerprint) are producer-attested provenance and must never be repairable by rewriting the header after a freshness refusal. Completion must bind acceptance to the recorded RUN snapshot, receipt/event chain and content digest and must REFUSE a header-only freshness repair; a canonical append-only RUN supersession/recheck operation is the legitimate route. Control: stale report -> manual source_head/fingerprint edit -> completion MUST refuse; a genuine new RUN with new evidence -> completion MAY pass.

SRC-274:R002.text: F-03 P1 cross-ticket checkpoint CAS: a phase decision or checkpoint naming a ticket that is not the current active ticket of the current phase must be refused with STALE_WORK_CONTEXT and ZERO LOG/BOARD/STATE writes, decided atomically against the expected ticket, phase, owner and last event. Retrospective evidence, where legitimately needed, uses a separate journal event class that cannot masquerade as a lifecycle decision. Control: a two-writer fixture in which T-1745 closes while T-1744 becomes current, then the stale checkpoint is refused.

SRC-274:R003.text: F-02 P1 fresh SAIHANDOFF admission: `continue` must not silently substitute persisted Work for a fresh substantial handoff. A new mission is admitted, queued or refused mechanically with that decision shown, and no ticket may be reported complete by unrelated prior work. Control: a session holding T-1745 receives an explicit handoff for another objective; the objective is neither dropped nor closed by a fabricated DONE.

SRC-274:R004.text: F-04/F-05 P1 authenticated ingress and runtime-home compatibility: operator provenance is carried as a machine-readable witness instead of being downgraded to model-supplied text, an untrusted claimed authority is refused, and a runtime-home rebind/failover is a canonical verdict requiring signed/hashed build identity, loaded source revision, ABI/schema compatibility, project/actor bindings and no pending operation. Without that verdict mutations are refused while read-only diagnosis remains available; no executable routing is guessed.

SRC-274:R005.text: F-06/F-09 P2 compound resolver and response policy: the compound-input resolver and the response/HUSH contract are exposed as one normative machine-readable schema with a verifiable resolver rather than repeated prose. Mixed commands such as a cleanup command plus `/goal cc all` preserve ordering, STOP and provenance.

SRC-274:R006.text: Ownership boundary: the ZAICODE host corrective track and the AUDAPACK consumer regression/acceptance track named in SRC-274 lie outside this receipt's SAIPEN authority. No ZAICODE or AUDAPACK project state is mutated under this Work; their items are recorded only so this ticket's scope cannot silently expand into them.

SRC-274:R007.text: Acceptance gate: the adverse controls are rerun on disposable projects and must show zero unauthorized effects, genuine red-before-green evidence, authentic source/ingress/owner binding, stable restart/replay and current native validation. Future and promotion gates stay CLOSED until evidence authority and concurrency defects are closed with live acceptance; no checkbox-only PASS and no bypass of operator or publication controls.
